groups.title: One more thing · local isn't free, it's unpriced

beats.label: Show the pricing miss
beats.cue: “No row in the pricing table matches llama3.2 — so the tracker charges zero and counts a miss. Zero dollars is not the same as free.”
beats.script: The terminal is running “Show the pricing miss” now; its output and exit status are the evidence for this beat. [[pause:1s]] No row in the pricing table matches llama3.2 — so the tracker charges zero and counts a miss. Zero dollars is not the same as free.
beats.command: bun -e 'import { TraceEventBus } from "@crewhaus/trace-event-bus"; import { createCostTracker } from "@crewhaus/cost-tracker"; const bus = new TraceEventBus({ runId: "run_local_0001", sessionId: "sess_local_0001" }); const t = createCostTracker(bus); bus.publish({ ...bus.envelope(), kind: "model_response", model: "llama3.2", provider: "openai", stopReason: "end_turn", usage: { input: 4000, output: 600 }, durationMs: 100 }); console.log("pricingMisses:", t.pricingMisses(), "· charged micros:", t.getRunCost("run_local_0001").totalUsdMicros);'

verify.note: prints “pricingMisses: 1 · charged micros: 0” — the miss counter is how you notice an unpriced model
